lines.x: The Spanish government announced it will extend its windfall tax on banks through 2027.
Spanish energy company Repsol has launched a €950 million share buyback program for 2026 and raised its planned January 2027 dividend to €0.56 per share.

Banco Santander has accumulated roughly €82 billion in synthetic risk transfer transactions, leading European lenders utilizing credit risk sales to capital investors to support dividends and share buybacks.
Airlines in Europe and Latin America are trimming flight routes and seat capacity after aviation fuel prices surged over 80% year-on-year, driving projected ticket prices up by more than 20%.
